database: BloodHound Legacy 4.0.3 / Neo4j 4.1.13 retained clean run

queries.runtime: CALL dbms.components() YIELD name, versions, edition RETURN name, versions, edition
queries.nodes_by_labels: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n) AS labels, count(n) AS count ORDER BY labels
queries.relationships_by_kind: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS kind, count(r) AS stored_count ORDER BY kind
queries.all_nodes: MATCH (n) RETURN n.objectid AS objectid, labels(n) AS labels ORDER BY objectid
queries.all_relationships: MATCH (s)-[r]->(t) RETURN s.objectid AS source, type(r) AS kind, t.objectid AS target, r.isacl AS isacl ORDER BY source, kind, target, isacl
queries.multiplicity: MATCH (s)-[r]->(t) WITH s.objectid AS source, type(r) AS kind, t.objectid AS target, count(r) AS stored_count RETURN source, kind, target, stored_count ORDER BY source, kind, target
queries.memberof: MATCH (s)-[r:MemberOf]->(t) RETURN s.objectid AS source, t.objectid AS target, r.isacl AS isacl ORDER BY source, target, isacl
queries.genericall: MATCH (s)-[r:GenericAll]->(t) RETURN s.objectid AS source, t.objectid AS target, r.isacl AS isacl ORDER BY source, target, isacl
queries.boundary_principals: MATCH (n) WHERE n.objectid IN $objectids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]->(t) RETURN n.objectid AS objectid, labels(n) AS labels, type(r) AS kind, t.objectid AS target ORDER BY objectid, kind, target
queries.exact_identity: MATCH (n {objectid: $objectid}) RETURN n.objectid AS objectid, labels(n) AS labels, n.name AS name
